name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with RefurbCheck
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

**Affected test / area**
Which check or UI section? (e.g. Battery, CPU deep stress, Report preview, Theme toggle, Info dialog, etc.)

**To reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open RefurbCheck in '...' (browser + OS)
2. Click '...'
3. See error / wrong result

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Actual behavior**
What actually happened (include any console errors if possible).

**Environment**
- Browser & version: [e.g. Chrome 124, Firefox 126, Safari 17]
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04]
- How opened: [GitHub Pages URL / local `docs/index.html` (file://)]
- RefurbCheck version/commit: [if known]

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.

> Note: RefurbCheck is a client-side tool with known browser limits (e.g. battery health/cycle count, RAM caps, Bluetooth/USB require Chromium). Please confirm the issue isn't a documented limitation before reporting.
